newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha steady in lacklustre market.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha steady in lacklustre market.

text.p: NWE naphtha was flat on Wednesday in a moribund market, traders said.
Swaps were assessed around $191/$192 for June paper and July a little above there at $192/$192.50.
Traders said little physical activity had been heard following Tuesday's deal at $184 cif Rotterdam for a Russian cargo of Dow spec material for pre-end May delivery.
A handful of bids around the $191-$192 mark for pipeline material were heard, although some traders said these were purely to bump the market higher.
Others countered that June prices were higher on the expectation of greater demand in June.
"People are trying to bid the market higher. They're bidding into a vacuum so it doesn't really mean anything," said one trader.
On the swaps front, trader assessed June paper at around $191/$192.
